name: micro-service-agent-devcontainer
postStartCommand: echo 'Checking services...' && timeout 30 bash -c 'until curl -sf http://redis:6379 >/dev/null 2>&1 || nc -z redis 6379 2>/dev/null; do echo Waiting for Redis...; sleep 2; done' && echo 'Redis is ready' && timeout 30 bash -c 'until curl -sf http://qdrant:6333/healthz 2>/dev/null | grep -q ok; do echo Waiting for Qdrant...; sleep 2; done' && echo 'Qdrant is ready' && echo 'All services are ready!'
